title: Golden Yellow Soap Dish, 4.5-Inch Wall-Mounted Solid Brass Bathroom Soap Dish, Concealed Mount, Allied Brass
description: Wall mounted soap dish for bathroom use, sized 4.5 inches long (4.5-inch, 4.5in) x 3 inches high (3-inch, 3in) x 3.5 inches wide (3.5-inch, 3.5in) with 5 inch projection — available in Golden Yellow, which radiates warm, sunny energy that brightens any bathroom with cheerful, optimistic personality. Solid brass construction bathroom soap dish holder keeps the sink area clean and clutter free. Use as a wall mount soap dish, wall-mounted soap holder, or bathroom soap dish tray. Concealed screw mounting hardware creates a clean look; mounting hardware included (uses #8 x 1 1/4" screws). Weight capacity: 2 lb; product weight: 1.6 lb. Fits traditional and transitional bath accessories, transitional bathroom hardware, and beaded bathroom hardware styling. Coordinate matching Dottingham pieces (Dottingham collection) for a unified bathroom. Limited Lifetime Warranty. Allied Brass Dottingham collection.
